method.latency: Warm helper buffers:3 warmups plus30 samples, or10 samples at8Mi+ UTF16 units; median/p95 include cooperative event-loop yields but exclude native reads/debounce/layout. Native UI includes80ms debounce. Two rAF callbacks are a presentation opportunity proxy, not GPU paint proof. Dense/results capped at300 may stop early.
method.cpu: Owned WebView2 cumulative OS process CPU counters bracket final operations and exclude Go. Whole-tree sampled CPU includes Go when at least2 distinct200ms samples exist, with the exact sample interval reported. ScriptDuration is only a reported renderer counter and undercounts async continuations; TaskDuration is a reported renderer work counter. CPU profiles are separately instrumented1000us sampled stack-time estimates, not exact CPU consumption. Whole-scenario totals include diagnostics, GC, screenshots and checks.
method.memory: Private committed bytes summed across owned Go+WebView2 processes, sampled200ms; shared working sets never summed. JS used heap sampled50ms; maxima are sampled, not absolute. Natural and forced-GC points are separate. Old forced-GC private samples may lag collection; final diagnostic waits for a fresh sample. Startup/opening1000notes is excluded; large existing Sidebar DOM contributes baseline memory.
method.comparisons: Baseline full matrix is supplemented by focused1000/cap16/oversized cases and separate varied corpus. Cold I/O is uncontrolled: preserve later focused cold/repeat outliers rather than claim consistently faster loads. Existing full baseline had1.3–8s cold outliers. Baseline helper/browser and current V8 agree in fixture/runtime; engine-agent Node comparisons use a different corpus/runtime and are not substituted here.
method.limits: 16Mi UTF16 snapshot cap.32Mi+ is deliberately partially searched and explicitly labels skipped notes; no full32Mi claim. Normal saved fixtures<=1MiB except explicit2MiB accepted boundary. Oversized20Mi recovery is anomalous synthetic data backed by a small saved source. Source hashes preserved. Baseline lacks the new multipage transport, so that row has no before observation.
